title: IngestionJob
description: The message the Go gateway pushes onto the Redis queue for Python workers to consume. Contains file-level facts only. Go never opens or parses the file contents; content-level facts (text, hash, chunks) are produced by the Python worker.

job_id.description: UUID v4 generated by the gateway. Also used as the stored filename stem.

original_filename.description: The filename as uploaded by the user, preserved for citation/display.

storage_path.description: Absolute path on the shared volume where the gateway saved the raw file. The worker reads from here. Swapping this to an S3/MinIO object key later is a one-field change.

content_type.description: MIME type the gateway assigned from the file extension. Note: text/csv is accepted at intake for future use, but the v1 worker pipeline does not yet implement CSV loading (deferred to v2) -- see load_document in tasks.py.

size_bytes.description: Size of the uploaded file in bytes.

uploaded_at.description: RFC3339 / ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the gateway accepted the upload.

source.description: How the file entered the system. Fixed to manual-upload for v1; leaves room for future ingestion sources (s3-sync, api-push, etc.).
